title: feat(scenarios): run-scenarios --packages published|workspace; the gallery exporter refuses workspace records
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X5KEQhDJwoAWVnx1AGDucTA)_

Fixes #31147

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:场景跑批器 `run-scenarios` 新增 `--packages published|workspace`,默认 `published`(行为不变)。`workspace` 先按发布的方式构建、`pnpm pack` 本仓所有会发布的包,再用打包出的 `create-objectstack` 原样脚手架项目,依赖与技能都装自这些 tarball;每份运行记录和计分卡首行写明包来源(`packages: published 18.3.0` 或 `packages: workspace @ SHA (unreleased)`)。画廊导出器只导出 `published` 的运行,`workspace` 记录(以及未写明来源的记录)一律拒绝。
- 为什么改:维护者裁决「两种都要」:发版后跑已发布的包,发版前用工作区未发布的包先测技能改动有没有让 AI 少犯错;未发布的结果绝不能进画廊。
- 第二轮(head `38562001`):CI 的 pnpm 是 Corepack 垫片,在仓外无 `packageManager` 的项目目录里会解析到 registry 最新版 pnpm 12,它不读 `npm_config_*`,于是装依赖时直奔 npm 而失败。现在 workspace 模式里脚手架和收尾安装用的每个 `pnpm` 都固定为本仓自己的版本(见下文 *pnpm is pinned to the workspace's*)。
- 风险与回滚:只动私有包 `@objectstack/scenarios`,不发布任何东西,`create-objectstack` 未改;`published` 路径的脚手架命令不变,只多读一次已装的 spec 版本写进记录。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/packages.ts`(打包、pnpmfile、overrides、安装后核验)、`src/export/record.ts` 的 `unpublishedRunRefusal` 与 `exporter.ts` 的调用点、`src/runner/cli.ts` 的 `--packages` 接线。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/runner/packages.test.ts test/export/exporter.test.ts`,预期 49/49 通过(含工作区独有技能标记落进 `.claude/skills/`、`workspace` 记录被导出器拒绝)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`run-scenarios --packages published|workspace`** (`runner/cli.ts`), default `published`, which keeps today's scaffold command (`npx -y create-objectstack@VERSION`) byte for byte. `--packages workspace` beside `--create-version` is refused: the version names a published scaffolder.
- **`workspace` mode** (`runner/packages.ts`, new), built once per run before the first card:
  1. Builds what the release builds for the packages it publishes: every non-private workspace package named `@objectstack/*` or `create-objectstack` (75 today), `turbo run build build:dist` filtered to them (`build:dist` is the Console copy the release's `console:build` makes).
  2. `pnpm pack`s each one: the tarball npm would serve, `files[]` only, every `workspace:` range rewritten to the version.
  3. Scaffolds with the packed `create-objectstack`, untouched: `npx -y file:TARBALL NAME`, its own install, its own skills sync, its own summary. Every `pnpm` it runs, and the install in step 4, is the workspace's own pinned pnpm (`pinnedPnpm`, see *Acceptance notes*). Its `pnpm install` is pointed at the tarballs by a global pnpmfile (`npm_config_global_pnpmfile`) whose `readPackage` hook rewrites every packed name in every dependency field of every manifest. The project's `package.json` is not rewritten: it pins the version, as a published scaffold does.
  4. Persists the same map as `overrides` in the project's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and installs again, so a later `pnpm add` by the agent stays on the tarballs.
  5. Verifies, and refuses the scaffold (the mode is skipped with the reason, like a failed scaffold) unless every `@objectstack/*` / `create-objectstack` entry in `node_modules/.pnpm` is a tarball (`@file+…`) and `.claude/skills/` holds the workspace build's catalog (`packages/skills/dist/skills`), skill for skill and file for file.
- **The package source in the record and the scorecard** (`runner/scorecard.ts`): `RunRecordMeta.packages` is required, so every record states it as `env.packages` (`{ source: 'published', versions }` or `{ source: 'workspace', commit, uncommitted }`) and `env.packagesLine`; the scorecard table's first line is `packages: published 18.3.0` or `packages: workspace @ SHA (unreleased)` (`+ uncommitted changes` when the tree had any). The published version is the `@objectstack/spec` each scaffolded project installed.
- **⛔ The gallery exporter refuses every run not on published packages** (`export/record.ts` `unpublishedRunRefusal`, checked in `exporter.ts` before the pass judgement): a `workspace` record, a record that states no package source (written before this flag), and a `published` record with no version are refused per card, with the reason; as for any refusal, an app the previous index listed is removed when its newest record is refused. The export CLI offers no flag around it.
- `runCommand` / `scaffold` (`runner/project.ts`) take an environment addition (the pnpmfile variable, and the `PATH` that leads with the pinned pnpm), merged over the existing environment. README: the `--packages` command line and a **Package source** paragraph.

## Why

The maintainer's ruling on the card, verbatim: 「两种都要」 — run on the published packages after each release, and a runner option to run on the workspace's unreleased packages beforehand, so a skill change can be measured before it ships. A workspace run's `@objectstack/spec` pin still reads `18.3.0` (the workspace has not been versioned), which is why the exporter cannot trust the version and refuses on the stated source instead.

## Tests

- **Workspace mode against a workspace of its own** (`test/runner/packages.test.ts`, new, 9 cases, ~3 s of tests): a temp pnpm workspace holding a skills catalog with a marker skill and a stand-in `create-objectstack` that does what the real one does in its order (write the manifest and `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, `pnpm install`, copy each skill). The pack, the `npx -y file:` scaffold, the pnpmfile and both installs are the real tools, at a version npm never published, so an install that reached for the registry fails instead of quietly finding something. Pins: only the released packages are built and packed (a `private` one is not) and the commit is stated; **the marker present only in the workspace build is in `.claude/skills/`** and the verification is empty; the installed package is the tarball (`@file+`), not a link, and a file outside `files` is absent; `package.json` keeps the version pin, `pnpm-workspace.yaml` gains the overrides, the lockfile carries no pnpmfile checksum; the hook rewrites only packed names, in every field; **every install ran the workspace's pinned pnpm** (the project's `node_modules/.modules.yaml` names the checkout's `pnpm --version`; the temp workspace declares that pin as the real root does). A failed scaffold reports its whole output. Negative pins: a published catalog in `.claude/skills/` (no marker, an extra skill) is refused file by file; a registry store entry is refused; a project with no pnpm store is refused.
- **Exporter** (`test/export/exporter.test.ts`, new top-level describe, 4 cases): a `workspace` record that passed every half (`judgeRecord` passes it) is refused and nothing of it is written; a newer `workspace` record removes the published export it follows; a record with no package source, and a published one with no version, are refused; a published run exports and its `scorecard.md` states `packages: published 18.3.0`.
- **Flag and line** (`test/runner/units.test.ts`, new describe, 3 cases): default `published`, `workspace` taken, an unknown value and `workspace` + `--create-version` refused; both line forms; the published version read from the installed spec. Existing record fixtures (`orchestrate.test.ts`, `export/fixture.ts`) now state `published 18.3.0`.

<details><summary>Ablations (each restored: blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

Ablations 1–3 run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor x1 → x0, replacement x0 → x1); the suites import `src/` directly, so no dist leg.

- Ablation 1, the exporter refusal disarmed (its `if (unpublished)` guard in `exporter.ts` ANDed with an always-false `String("ABL1").length` comparison): `exporter.test.ts -t 'only a run on published packages'` → `3 failed | 1 passed` (the workspace, newer-workspace and unstated/versionless cases red; the published case green).
- Ablation 2, the skills file comparison disarmed (its `if (differ.length)` guard in `packages.ts` ANDed with an always-false `String("ABL2").length` comparison): `packages.test.ts` → `1 failed | 7 passed` (the published-catalog refusal).
- Ablation 3, the pnpmfile variable renamed (`ABL3_npm_config_global_pnpmfile`): `packages.test.ts` → the `beforeAll` scaffold answers exit 1 (the install reaches for a version npm never published), the suite reds, 5 cases do not run.
- Ablation 4 (round 2, on the `packages.ts` that `38562001` carries, by a saved copy of `packages.ts` restored with `cmp` clean), the shim dropped from the scaffold's `PATH` (`env.PATH` set to the inherited `PATH`), run under a CI-shaped Corepack (`COREPACK_HOME` set, `corepack enable` into a temp bin first on `PATH`, `CI=true`): `packages.test.ts` → the `beforeAll` scaffold answers exit 1 with CI's exact error, `No matching version found for @objectstack/skills@0.0.0-scenario-workspace-test while fetching it from https://registry.npmjs.org/`; restored, `9 passed`.

</details>

<details><summary>Live workspace scaffold, no model (the order's no-live-run rule held)</summary>

Measured in this container on the branch after a release-shape build of the scaffold closure plus the Console (`turbo run build build:dist`, 98 tasks, 15 min 14 s, exit 0):

- Packed 75 tarballs in 20 s; scaffold with the packed `create-objectstack` exit 0 in 14 s; settle (overrides + install, `Already up to date`) exit 0 in 7 s.
- `node_modules/.pnpm`: 61 `@objectstack/*` entries, 0 not from a tarball; `@objectstack/spec` resolves to `.pnpm/@objectstack+spec@file+..+..+workspace-packages+objectstack-spec-18.3.0.tgz`.
- `.claude/skills/`: 11 skills, byte-identical to `packages/skills/dist/skills` (the catalog's top-level `README.md` is not a skill and is not synced, measured with `diff -rq`); `skills-lock.json` entries `source: @objectstack/skills`, `sourceType: node_modules`.
- `objectstack validate` in the project: exit 0. `objectstack dev --fresh` (`bootDev`): `/api/v1/health` 200 after 13 s, stopped.
- Control: a published `create-objectstack@18.3.0` scaffold of the same name, run through the same verification, is refused on every `@objectstack/*` store entry (registry) and on 47 skill files that differ from the workspace catalog — the check tells the two apart on today's `main`.
- A first measurement used `npx -y --package=TARBALL create-objectstack`: the scaffold exited 0 with no skills, because npx hands `--package` to its child as `npm_config_package` and the scaffolder's own `npx -y skills@1.7.2 …` then ran `skills@1.7.2` as a bin of the scaffolder's tarball (`sh: 1: skills@1.7.2: not found`). The verification refused it; the scaffold now names the tarball positionally (`npx -y file:TARBALL`), as the published one is named.
- A recorded-driver end-to-end run (`--driver recorded:F`) is NOT MEASURED (listed below).

</details>

## NOT MEASURED

- A recorded-driver end-to-end run (`--driver recorded:F`). No recording of a card exists in this container, and making one needs a live model run, which is paused.
- The agent's own later `pnpm add` in a workspace-mode project. It runs whatever pnpm that project directory resolves, because the pin covers only the runner's scaffold and settle steps. It stays on the tarballs through the `overrides` persisted in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, but that mechanism is measured on pnpm 10.31 only. Under a Corepack whose unpinned default is a later major, it is not measured.

## Acceptance notes

- **pnpm is pinned to the workspace's (round 2).** Round 1 went red on Test Core (5/8) for `packages.test.ts`, while it was green locally. CI's `pnpm` is a Corepack shim, and the scaffolded project lives in a temp directory outside the checkout with no `packageManager` field, so Corepack resolved the registry's `latest` there: pnpm 12.18.0 on 2026-11-07. pnpm 12 reads none of `npm_config_*`, so the global pnpmfile went unread and the install asked npm for a version it never published. The container measured green only because its `pnpm` is a standalone 10.31.0. A real run on a machine whose pnpm is Corepack's would have failed the same way, so the fix is in the runner and not only in the test. `prepareWorkspacePackages` now writes a `pnpm` shim (`pinnedPnpm`, `runner/packages.ts`). It runs the `pnpm` on `PATH` from inside the checkout, where Corepack (or pnpm's own version management) resolves the root's `packageManager` pin, and points it at the caller's directory with `--dir`. The shim is refused unless it answers the same `--version` the checkout does. The scaffold and the settle install both run under a `PATH` led by it. The settle install still runs without the pnpmfile, so the lockfile records no pnpmfile checksum. Measured under a CI-shaped Corepack: the Corepack store afterwards holds only the pinned 10.31.0 and no `lastKnownGood.json`, so the `setup-pnpm` store guard's incident shape is not armed. The shim is a POSIX `sh` script, so workspace mode runs on Linux and macOS, not on Windows.

- **Why a pnpmfile and then overrides, not one of them.** The scaffolder writes `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and installs in the same process, so overrides cannot be in place before its install; a global pnpmfile is the one pnpm 10.31 reads from the environment (`npm_config_global_pnpmfile`; `pnpm_config_global_pnpmfile` is not read, measured: the install reached for the registry). A lockfile written under a pnpmfile records its checksum, and a later install without it would re-resolve from npm; the persisted overrides plus the second install remove that path. Running the scaffolder with `--skip-install` and installing in the runner was rejected: it would copy the scaffolder's skills command into the runner, where a later bump of its pinned `skills` CLI would not follow.
- **Pack, not link**, as the card expected: a tarball holds `files[]` only (pinned: a file outside `files` is absent from the installed package).
- **Scope of the overrides**: every package the release publishes, not only the scaffold's closure, so a package the agent adds later is the workspace's too.
- **Workspace mode needs pnpm** for the scaffolder's install; with npm the verification finds no `.pnpm` store and refuses the scaffold, never a silent npm install. The runner already runs inside this pnpm workspace.
- **A record written before this PR states no package source and is refused by the exporter**; run the card again. Records are local, git-ignored output, and the gallery is not live yet.
- The build step is the release's own and runs through turbo; a second run of an unchanged tree is a cache hit. A cold build of the scaffold closure plus the Console took 15 min here.
- No change to `create-objectstack`: the scaffolder needed no hook, so nothing published moves and no changeset is owed (`skip-changeset`).

## Verification

**Round 2, head `38562001`** (one commit on `4551309a`, touching `runner/packages.ts` and `test/runner/packages.test.ts` only):

- Reproduced CI's red under a CI-shaped Corepack (above). With the fix, `packages.test.ts` reports `9 passed` both under that Corepack and under the standalone pnpm. The whole package under Corepack reports `Test Files 24 passed (24)`, `Tests 471 passed (471)`. `tsc --noEmit` exits 0.
- Derived gates: 51 commands, all `exit 0`; `--ran` reconciliation: `51 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. A first pass on the round-2 commit had `check:cross-package-test-inputs` exit 1, because the test read the repo-root `package.json` for the pin. The test now asks `pnpm --version` in its own directory instead, and the gate exits 0.

**Round 1**: all on head `4551309a`, in worktree `objectstack-issue-31147`, base `8ef4d309`; `origin/main` has moved 8 commits since, none under `packages/qa/scenarios`, `packages/create-objectstack` or `packages/skills`, and `git merge-tree` is clean.

- Package suite, under the verify lock after `pnpm --filter "@objectstack/scenarios..." build`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test` → `Test Files 24 passed (24)`, `Tests 470 passed (470)`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`, tests included) exit 0; `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Lint scoped to the package: `pnpm exec eslint packages/qa/scenarios --no-inline-config` exit 0.
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 51 commands; all 51 run, each `exit 0`; `--ran` reconciliation: `51 derived, 51 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. (A first round on an earlier head read `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, prerequisite not met; after `git fetch --depth=1` of the self-test's pinned commit and the package build, both exit 0 on this head.)
- Changeset: none. The diff touches only the private `@objectstack/scenarios` (`"private": true`): `skip-changeset`.
- Dogfood battery: n/a (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
